title: Search Me, O God
lyrics_original: Where once I burned with shame

bible_verses.english: Search me, God, and know my heart. Test me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
Create in me a clean heart, God. Renew a right spirit within me.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, search my heart today and know my deepest thoughts. Reveal anything in me that hinders my walk with You, and gently cleanse me from every sin. Thank You for the priceless gift of Your forgiveness that breaks every chain and sets my heart free. Create in me a clean heart, Lord, and lead me in Your everlasting way. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, search my heart today and know my deepest thoughts. Reveal anything in me that hinders my walk with You, and gently cleanse me from every sin. devotional.reflection_english: It takes gentle courage to invite God to search the quietest corners of our hearts. Yet, when we bring our hidden struggles and mistakes into His light, we do not meet condemnation, but a loving Father who welcomes us. As this song reminds us, the Lord desires to cleanse us from every sin and set us fully free. When we surrender our hearts to Him today, we open the door to His transforming peace and boundless grace.
